title: DreamCo O*NET Occupation Synthesis (skeleton)
summary: Skeleton for a DreamCo-authored synthesis layer (study plans, task/skill groupings, evaluation prompts) built on top of attributed O*NET database content. No data assets are included yet; this version exists to exercise the license/provenance gate and release-artifact checks.

source_versions.cip_onet_soc_crosswalk: CIP 2020 to O*NET-SOC 2019 (Education_CIP_to_ONET_SOC.xlsx sha256 4802101afb1dfa83acde5d125bc55170410686c6d379a8d893c74447361ea6e8; see provenance_manifest.json)

known_limitations: Skeleton only: no data assets, no sample records, no quality or benchmark evidence.
license_gate_status is pending (pre-gate): no included assets, so no asset gate results exist to roll up to pass | fail | reference_only_bundle.
No dataset scorecard has been run (scorecard_score null); not eligible for any commercial tier.
No owner approval recorded; package is not for sale and has no sales channel or price.

O*NET pinned to 31.0 for this package version. The fleet catalog tool (tools/build_universal_work_ai_catalog.py) still defaults to 30.3; DP-ONET builds override it with --onet-zip-url pointing at db_31_0_excel.zip. 31.0 splits Skills into Essential Skills and Transferable Skills; there is no single Skills file.
O*NET content is third-party (USDOL/ETA, CC BY 4.0); only the DreamCo synthesis layer can be DreamCo-owned, and attribution plus the USDOL/ETA non-endorsement notice must ship with every derivative.
US occupational taxonomy only (O*NET-SOC 2019); not validated for other labor markets.

changes: Initial skeleton: manifest, license, dataset card, provenance/license manifests, not_run quality and benchmark stubs, empty sample/.

Manifest aligned to plan section 5.2: sku_id, version, contents_digest, included_asset_ids, excluded_reference_only_sources, license_gate_status (pending | pass | fail | reference_only_bundle); stripe_price_id optional and unset.

Pinned O*NET 31.0 (download URLs + sha256 in provenance_manifest.json); recorded the 31.0 Essential/Transferable Skills split and the 30.3 tool-default override. Still no assets, gate pending, no price.

truth_boundary: Skeleton package. Not production ready, not for sale, and no quality, benchmark, or rights claims are made beyond what the attached reports show (all not_run or pending).
